profile_text.body:
Writesonic is a San Francisco, California-based software company that describes itself as "The AI Search Growth Engine," offering a platform focused on generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility. The company's site states the platform tracks visibility, citations, and sentiment across 10 AI platforms and more than 50 markets, drawing on what it describes as a dataset of 2 billion or more real AI conversations updated weekly. Writesonic names Amazon, Unilever, Acer, and NP Digital as customers.

The platform's stated capabilities include an AI agent that rewrites web pages to add FAQ blocks, comparison tables, and passages structured for AI citation, as well as tools to surface third-party sources such as Reddit threads, YouTube videos, and high-domain-rating listicles that cite competitors, with automated outreach drafts. It also offers technical auditing of robots.txt, schema, indexing, and broken pages flagged by crawlers including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot. Results are measured at day 14 and day 28 intervals across citation share, AI traffic, conversions, and pipeline. Additional tiers cover white-label agency reporting and product-feed optimization aimed at placements in ChatGPT Shopping and similar AI recommendation surfaces.

The site's tracked product, WriteSonic, is categorized as a writing and editing tool for marketing copy, reflecting an earlier product focus that the company's current messaging has broadened into AI search optimization. No litigation or regulatory filings appear in the held facts, though the profile carries a California law-exposure marker consistent with the company's San Francisco headquarters.
